To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
Ectromedia virus is able to induce syncytia formation in-vitro under neutral pH conditions.
ectromelia virus induces syncytia formation under neutral conditions and that this process is independent of the fusion inhibiting complex.
ectromelia virus, like vaccinia virus, induces cell-cell fusion.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the induction of cell-cell fusion and its inhibition by the fusion inhibitory proteins.
the induction of cell-cell fusion and the role of the A56/K2 complex in this process.
the induction of syncytia in the absence of the fusion inhibiting complex and the role of the fusion complex in cell-cell fusion.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
ECTV cell-cell fusion is not inhibited by the FIC.
the ECTV A/K2 complex is not involved in the regulation of cell-cell fusion.
Ectromedia virus induces cell-cell syncytia in-vitro as well as in-vivo, irrespectively of the presence of its fusion inhibitory proteins A56 and K3.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
ECTV induces cell-cell fusion in a similar manner to vaccinia virus.
the fusion of ECTV with vaccinia virus has been used as a model system to study the mechanism of cell-cell fusion.
